RUN.meaning: Launch from the persisted packet after dependency/context/budget/conflict checks.

CONTINUE.meaning: Launch the next bounded execution from the last verified checkpoint.

PAUSE.meaning: Prevent further launches; active runtime cancellation is implementation-specific.

RESUME.meaning: Return a paused packet to READY.

STOP.meaning: Stop future continuation and request cancellation of any active execution.

RETRY.meaning: Return failed/blocked/stopped work to READY subject to launch guards.

REASSIGN_MODEL.meaning: Change preferred model; Gateway still applies qualification and policy.

ADJUST_BUDGET.meaning: Change hard worker budget; cannot go below already-consumed spend.

SEND_TO_REVIEW.meaning: Mark a NEEDS_REVIEW candidate PENDING for independent review.

bulk.RUN_ALL_READY: Launch only dependency-ready, funded, non-conflicting READY packets.
bulk.RUN_PHASE: Same eligibility rules, filtered to the requested phase.

completion_rule: Worker self-report can create NEEDS_REVIEW only. COMPLETE requires an independent approved review decision.
